== Mis-name ==

When something like that happens, an admin dosen't have to fix it. All you have to do is go to the article page, click on the "Move" link, and input the correct name of the article. I've done it for Birlen Pena. This will create a redirect from the old name to the new. Just make sure you go back and categorize the redirect. Let me know if you need any help with anything else.  : ) ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#000099;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 13:42, January 14, 2010 (UTC)
